## What this site is

Unofficial **personal study notes** for publicly available lecture series (NPTEL *Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning*, Coder Army *Spring Boot Full Course*, and others as added).

This site is **not** affiliated with NPTEL, IISc, Coder Army, or the course instructors.

## What we publish

- Original notes and explanations written for learning
- Tutorials and code examples created for this site
- Links to official lecture videos and course pages

## What we do not publish

- Lecture video or audio files
- Official course PDFs/slides redistributed wholesale
- Verbatim lecture transcripts

## Credit

When notes follow a specific lecture, the page names the course, instructor, and links the source video.

Examples:

- Prof. Prathosh A.P., NPTEL / IISc — [Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning](https://nptel.ac.in/courses/106108841)
- Aditya Tandon, Coder Army — [Spring Boot Full Course playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEYgx5hMdopw)

## Your use

You may read and learn from these notes. If you reuse material, please keep attribution to both this site and the original lecture sources.
